headline: Snow Hits the Castle as Halloween Winds Down
tagline: Two weeks of spooky fun left, a Magic Key perk lands, and the holidays kick off Nov 13.

lead.title: Magic Key Holders Get More Flexibility
lead.body: Disneyland Resort is dropping the Magic Key no-show penalty, and holders can now modify or cancel park reservations until 11:59 p.m. PT on the day of the visit. Reservations are still required.

events.title: Oogie Boogie Bash
events.body: The after-hours Halloween party at Disney California Adventure debuts "Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party." Many dates have sold out; check the official calendar for what's left.

events.title: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: Both parks are decked out for the season, including the "Mickey's Trick and Treat" daytime show.

events.title: Plaza de la Familia
events.body: A Día de los Muertos celebration featuring a Coco-themed street show, live mariachi and a memory wall.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the Haunted Mansion runs into the new year.

events.title: Castle Snow Arrives
events.body: The first snow has appeared on Sleeping Beauty Castle, with the seasonal display nearly complete.

events.title: World of Color – One
events.body: The fan-favorite World of Color show wraps its limited run before the holiday show takes over.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Disney Lorcana: Hyperia City Release
events.body: The new set launches at Disney's Pin Traders in Downtown Disney District; join the virtual queue in the Disneyland app starting at 5 a.m.

events.title: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: Returning favorites include "Believe … in Holiday Magic" fireworks, "A Christmas Fantasy Parade" and it's a small world Holiday, plus a new Santa spot at Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn and Festival of Holidays at DCA.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition of World of Color returns to Paradise Bay.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: Hunt for hidden ornaments around Downtown Disney District and redeem your map for a keepsake. Start date unconfirmed, so check Disneyland.com.

tip: Most Halloween and holiday entertainment is included with park admission. Oogie Boogie Bash needs its own ticket, and Magic Key holders can now cancel reservations same-day.
caveats: Dates come from Disney press releases and fan sites as of Oct 15, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
